parked.spanish: Y se acercará Moisés solo a Jehová, y ellos no se acercarán, y el pueblo no subirá con él.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3mp is smoothed to singular subirá to agree with the singular collective el pueblo.

parked.spanish: Y envió a los jóvenes de hijos de Israel, y subieron holocaustos, y sacrificaron sacrificios, pazes, a Jehová, toros.

findings.issue: H8002 is a masculine plural absolute noun for the peace-offering sacrifice. pazes is an irregular plural of abstract paz and omits that offering.
Hiphil sequential 3mp (cause to go up) is smoothed as transitive subieron; the plural object holocaustos still carries the raising.

readerNotes.note: Comma added before que so the relative clause can be read over the whole series (las tablas, la ley y el mandamiento) rather than attaching only to el mandamiento.
The Hebrew clause 'מי בעל דברים' has no verb, so 'sea' is a supplied copula, marked here in italics.
